findings.text: Provides four observation and update operations for a shared error sequence counter: record a new error, take a lightweight sample, test whether the value moved since a prior sample, and test plus advance a caller cursor while marking the shared value as observed.

Provides two read-only queries over registered injection ranges: a membership test for an address and a lookup of the injectable error kind covering an address, with a negative invalid-argument result when uncovered.

Provides ordering, trimming and lookup operations for exception tables: sort a table by decoded instruction address, drop init-resident entries from either end of a module table, and binary search a sorted table for an instruction address.

Provides a generic in-place sort accepting a base pointer, element count and size plus caller comparison and optional exchange callbacks, delegating to a common internal routine that also supports a rescheduling-tolerant mode.
Provides formatted input scanning from a memory buffer into variadic outputs, plus a fault-attribute string parser extracting four tuning fields and reporting success or parse failure.

Registration record for one injectable function range holding intrusive list linkage, inclusive start and exclusive end addresses, a numeric error kind, and an opaque owner handle used for bulk removal.
Sequence iteration descriptor for the injection list wiring start, next, stop and show handlers so iteration holds the central lock and renders one entry per step.
Small container grouping a fault attribute object for user-copy failure injection, initialized from a static initializer and later exposed through boot and debug interfaces.

A single mutex serializes all mutation and traversal of the global injection list, including membership tests, type lookups, bulk population and owner-scoped removal; each operation acquires on entry and releases before returning.
Debug listing nests list traversal inside the same central mutex by acquiring in the start handler and releasing in the stop handler, so next and show run with the lock held.

Population walks a caller-supplied descriptor range, resolves each descriptor to a runtime address, discards entries failing kernel-text or size resolution with a diagnostic, and otherwise appends a freshly allocated range record whose extent is address plus resolved size and whose kind and owner come from the inputs.

Module load appends entries only when the module advertises injectable functions, passing the module as owner; unload removes exactly those records whose owner matches, unlinking and freeing each while holding the lock.

Recording validates that the supplied error is non-zero and within range, then repeatedly attempts an atomic compare-exchange replacing stored error bits while preserving counter bits, advancing the counter only when the prior value had been observed, treating no-change or lost-race-to-same-value as success.

Sampling returns zero when the shared value was never observed and otherwise returns the stored value; equality against a prior sample means no new error, while the advancing check marks the shared value observed and returns the stored error magnitude as a negative result.

Sort and search share the same decoded-address ordering that avoids arithmetic overflow by branching on greater, less, else equal, so the table produced by the sort comparator is directly searchable by the binary search comparator.
Trimming repeatedly drops leading entries and then trailing entries while the decoded address of the examined end belongs to module init text, adjusting the base pointer and count accordingly.

The internal sorter treats fewer than two elements or zero size as a no-op, selects a default exchange strategy from alignment and width capabilities when the caller supplies none, and otherwise dispatches through caller or sized-word or byte exchanges chosen by a central helper.

Sorting builds a heap from the middle toward the base and then repeatedly extracts the largest elements toward the tail, sifting along a child-selection path and backtracking to the insertion point using a size-scaled parent computation, optionally yielding the processor between iterations and finishing with a small-tail fix-up.

Numeric conversions skip leading blanks, accept an optional sign for signed forms, select radix from the conversion letter with auto detection for one form, enforce digit validity per radix and width limits, parse through bounded string-to-integer helpers, and store through width-selected output pointer kinds.

Template whitespace consumes arbitrary input blanks, literal characters must match exactly, suppression skips a blank-delimited input field, one conversion reports consumed length without counting as a match, character and word copying honor width defaults, set matching requires a width and a non-empty match from an explicit set with optional negation, and a doubled delimiter matches one literal with unknown letters ending the scan.

Each stored sequence value cycles among unobserved, observed, and re-recorded states: a fresh record clears the observed flag, a reader sets it, and a later record finding it set also bumps the generation counter, letting later observations distinguish a repeated error from a new one.
Module membership follows notifier transitions: arrival triggers population for that module while departure triggers owner-scoped removal, with unrelated notifications acknowledged without action.

Listing moves from locked start through repeated next and show steps to unlocking stop; show renders the current record as a symbolic address plus a textual error-kind label with a fallback label for unknown kinds.

Bring-up first populates kernel-resident descriptors, then attempts module-notifier registration where available, and only on successful registration creates the debug listing; one configuration always reports registration success without installing a notifier.
Boot initialization entry populates the kernel-resident injection whitelist before any module or debug setup runs.

Separate setup entries create the debug directory and read-only listing with cleanup on failure, register the module membership notifier with neutral priority, and dispatch membership events to load or unload helpers.

Fault injection setup entries parse a boot string into the user-copy fault attribute, initialize random state once on first use, and publish the attribute through a debug entry while propagating creation errors as negative codes.

If allocation fails midway through population the routine stops and leaves previously appended entries in place while still holding the lock; invalid addresses are skipped individually rather than aborting the whole range.
Recording a zero error or one whose magnitude exceeds the supported maximum triggers a warning diagnostic and leaves the stored sequence unchanged, returning the prior value.

Set matching differs from common library behaviour by treating dashes literally, being unable to match a closing bracket, requiring a width, and rejecting discard-with-set forms; several malformed templates or exhausted inputs end early returning only conversions completed so far.

Instruction decoding, table exchange, alignment checks, word-width exchanges and a test scheduler hook each have build-dependent variants, including direct versus address-relative decoding, null versus offset-adjusting exchange with optional extra fix-up, base-sensitive versus size-only alignment, wide versus paired narrow transfers, and an empty test rescheduling stub.

Sequence word partitions low bits for error magnitude, one flag bit marking observation, and upper bits for a generation counter; shift derives from binary width of the maximum error plus one, the flag is one shifted by that amount, the mask is flag minus one, and the counter step is one shifted past flag and error bits.

Extended error name table covers the high error range beginning at five twelve through five fifty, indexed by subtracting the base with a compile-time range check, storing a dash-prefixed decimal rendering for each slot.

Numeric injection kinds render as short uppercase labels for null, error-number, combined, and true kinds, with a parenthesized unknown label for any other value, paired with a symbolic address in list output.

Fault tuning text holds four comma-separated decimal fields for interval, likelihood, spacing and repetition; the error injection debug directory and read-only list entry plus the user-copy failure attribute expose these controls.
